A company holiday that falls within an employee's approved period of Annual Leave will not normally
be deducted from the employee's Annual Leave balance. For example, if an employee takes Annual Leave from Monday through Friday and Wednesday is a
designated company holiday, only four Annual Leave days will normally be deducted. A maximum of 10 unused Annual Leave days may be carried forward. Any Annual Leave balance exceeding the permitted carry-forward limit will expire at the end of the
